flag-a#62.notes: chunky rectangular flag in a gentle wave on a brown pole with a gold knob; clean black outline, plain white cloth with two clear grey fold bands, so the per-player recolour keeps its shading; reads at native size on light and dark

flag-a#9.notes: crisp swallowtail but a flat cloth with no shade tone: recoloured it reads as a flat sticker

flag-a#4.notes: good wave but noisy diagonal shading streaks that break up when recoloured

flag-a#38.notes: close second; ragged lower edge reads as torn cloth

flag-a#47.notes: deep swallowtail notch makes the flag look torn at small size

flag-a#2.notes: stripy shading bands read as a pattern once recoloured
